# cmd/constitution-lint/waivers.txt
# Packages waived from the schema-presence check.
# One module-relative path per line; # comments and blank lines are ignored.
#
# A waiver is legitimate only for "behavioral-only" packages: packages that
# expose interfaces, middleware, or pure logic with no data-contract surface of
# their own. If a package defines structs that cross a package boundary as
# configuration or data, it needs a schema.cue.
#
# To add a waiver: add the path here AND document the reason in the adjacent
# comment. To remove one: delete the line and create schema.cue.

# ── foundations/agent ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# bounded-exec: behavioral subprocess runner — no data contract, pure behavior.
foundations/agent/bounded-exec
# conversation: behavioral conversation-state machine — protocol logic only.
foundations/agent/conversation
# mcp-client: behavioral MCP client — transport + handshake + bridge, no data
# contract surface of its own (the wire format is JSON-RPC, defined by the MCP
# spec, not by this package's CUE schema).
foundations/agent/mcp-client
# (tool-registry's waiver was removed 2026-09-02: it now defines #Tool/#Effect
# in schema.cue — a real data contract — so the waiver's premise is gone.)

# ── foundations/cache ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# result-cache: generic TTL+LRU memoization — pure behavioral, no contract surface.
foundations/cache/result-cache

# ── foundations/communications ───────────────────────────────────────────────
# clarification-loop: pure behavioral state machine — no shared data type.
foundations/communications/clarification-loop

# ── foundations/distribution ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
# (artifact-builder and artifact-store retired Wave 4 — zero consumers)

# ── foundations/embedding ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# embedding-client: Embedder interface + CachingEmbedder — behavioral only.
foundations/embedding/embedding-client
# vector-store: VectorStore interface + MemoryVectorStore — behavioral only.
foundations/embedding/vector-store

# ── foundations/evidence ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# doc-provider: DocProvider interface + in-memory impls — behavioral only.
foundations/evidence/doc-provider
# evidence-resolver: ref→span registry — behavioral, no data contract surface.
foundations/evidence/evidence-resolver
# source-linker: span↔source link sets — behavioral, no CUE schema surface.
foundations/evidence/source-linker
#
# NOTE: foundations/evidence/evidence-anchor is NOT waived — a parallel agent
# is landing schema.cue for it. Remove this comment once it lands.

# ── foundations/governance ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
# answer-cache: two-level match cache — behavioral middleware, no contract.
foundations/governance/answer-cache
# identity: privacy-preserving identity extraction — behavioral (hash logic only).
foundations/governance/identity
# topic-gate: cheapest-first scope decision — behavioral middleware only.
foundations/governance/topic-gate

# ── foundations/investigation ────────────────────────────────────────────────
# investigation-memo: keyed Store interface + in-memory impl — behavioral only.
foundations/investigation/investigation-memo

# ── foundations/llmclient ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# llmclient root (foundations/llmclient) is documented as behavioral-only in
# TRACKING.md §1.2. All sub-packages below are middleware/test-doubles/adapters
# with no independent data contract.
#
# claudecli: CLI shell-out adapter — behavioral only, no data contract of its
# own (wraps the `claude` binary's own JSON envelope; there is no CUE-owned
# shape this package defines).
foundations/llmclient/claudecli
# codexcli: CLI shell-out adapter, modeled on claudecli — behavioral only, no
# data contract of its own (wraps the `codex` binary's own JSONL event
# stream; there is no CUE-owned shape this package defines).
foundations/llmclient/codexcli
# egress: WithEgress middleware — wraps LLMClient, no contract of its own.
foundations/llmclient/egress
# instrument: WithTelemetry/WithCost middleware — no data contract.
foundations/llmclient/instrument
# llm-test: conformance test suite — test helper, no data contract.
foundations/llmclient/llm-test
# noop: no-op LLMClient implementation — behavioral stub only.
foundations/llmclient/noop
# replay: record/replay cassettes — behavioral adapter, no CUE schema surface.
foundations/llmclient/replay

# ── foundations/persistence ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
# jsonl-log: append-log writer/reader — behavioral I/O primitive.
foundations/persistence/jsonl-log

# NOTE: foundations/quality/fitness-function-registry is NOT waived — a parallel
# agent is landing schema.cue for it.

foundations/retrieval/fuzzy

foundations/retrieval/thread-resolver

# ── foundations/review ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# review-queue: priority queue — behavioral, no data contract.
foundations/review/review-queue
# run-audit-record: append-only audit log — behavioral primitive.
foundations/review/run-audit-record
# run-report: deterministic Markdown renderer over run inputs — behavioral
# renderer, no data-contract surface of its own (input types mirror caller
# structs from harness/journal/telemetry; no CUE schema needed).
foundations/review/run-report
# scoring: pure-math scoring helpers — behavioral, no CUE contract surface.
foundations/review/scoring

# ── foundations/security ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# httpauth: bearer-token auth middleware — behavioral, no data-contract surface

foundations/security/httpauth
